EC1: Patients with any other primary DSM-IV psychiatric diagnosis [AND] [NOT] in addition to Obsessive Compulsive Disorder.
EC2: Patients who currently fulfil criteria for DSM-IV eating disorder [OR], body dysmorphic disorder [OR], current alcohol [OR] or substance abuse [OR], or who have a lifetime history of bipolar disorder [OR]. Patients with a history of Schizophrenia [OR] and other psychotic disorders [OR], Delirium [OR], Dementia [OR], and Amnestic [OR] and other cognitive disorders.
EC3: Subjects with a concurrent Axis II Cluster A Personality Disorder
EC5: Subjects who based on history or mental status examination have a significant risk of committing suicide, in the investigator's opinion.
EC6: Subjects with a history of more than three adequate trials with an SSRI.
EC7: Subjects who have had an adequate trial of pregabalin.
EC8: Subjects who have initiated psychotherapy in the last 4 months prior to the first visit.
EC9: Subjects who, during the course of the study, would be likely to require treatment with prohibited concomitant therapy .
EC10: Prior use of or a known allergy [OR] or hypersensitivity [AND] to pregabalin.
EC11: Subjects who have participated in any clinical trial within 30 days prior to entering the study, or in a clinical trial involving a psychotropic medication within the 6 months prior to entering the study.
EC12: Any subject who has been taking benzodiazepines before entering the study who: 1) cannot tolerate being free of benzodiazepines for 4 weeks, or 2) has signs or symptoms of benzodiazepine withdrawal or rebound at the end of those 4 weeks. Should a patient entering the study, who is currently on benzodiazepines develop discontinuation symptoms with discontinuation of their benzodiazepine, we will treat these symptoms with a more gradual benzodiazepine taper. Study will be delayed until the patient is able to tolerate the discontinuation for 4 weeks.
EC13: Patients with a current seizure disorder [OR], organic brain disorder [OR] or a history of seizure disorders [AND] ([NOT] except for febrile seizures in childhood).
EC14: Patients with thyroid pathology [AND], the treatment of which has [NOT] not been stabilized for at least three months.
EC15: Patients on neuroleptic drugs [OR] in the two months prior to study entry or cognitive behavioural therapy [AND] specific to OCD within four weeks of study entry
EC16: Pregnant or lactating females, or if sexually active and of childbearing potential, not using adequate methods of birth control.
EC17: Patients with a history or evidence of a medical condition that would expose them to an increased risk of a significant adverse event or interfere with assessments of safety and efficacy during the trial.
EC18: Patients receiving psychotropics of any kind, including betablockers [OR] and other anticonvulsants. [NOT] Sleep medication such as oral chloral-hydrate [OR] or zopiclone are acceptable.
EC19: Patients using any herbal psychoactive treatments, e.g. St John's Wort [OR], Valerian [OR], Kava Kava [OR], L-tryptophan.
EC20: Patients with any condition or on any therapy that, in the investigator's opinion, or as indicated in the pregabalin product label, may pose a risk to the subject.
EC21: Patients who have had a major life event in the past three months, which in the judgement of the investigator is influencing their current condition.
EC22: Patients having clinically significant abnormal laboratory [OR], or ECG findings not resolved by further examinations.
